description: This Java class defines an Android IntentService called DeleteQuestionService, which communicates with Google Play Services Wearable API to update the data item associated with a question, marking it as deleted when a user dismisses it on a smartwatch.

classes.name: DeleteQuestionService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that updates a data item on a connected wearable device to mark a question as deleted when dismissed.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with its simple class name.

methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient with Wearable API for communications.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles the incoming intent to update the data item on the wearable, marking the question as deleted.
